exhibitors.companyDescriptionCn:
3M公司创建于1902年，全球总部位于美国明尼苏达州的圣保罗市。作为一家世界领先的多元化科技创新企业，3M的产品和技术早已深深地融入人们的生活。100多年以来，3M开发了六万多种产品，从家庭用品到医疗产品，从运输、建筑到商业、教育和电子、通信等各个领域。
3M中国有限公司于1984年11月在上海注册成立，是在深圳经济特区外成立的中国第一家外商独资企业。截止目前，3M公司在中国建立了9个生产基地、20个办事处、4个技术中心和1个研发中心。
作为最早进入中国的外商独资企业之一， 3M中国在过去的30多年里始终密切把握中国经济的发展脉搏，秉承“扎根中国，服务中国”的本土化发展战略，凭借多元化的技术和解决方案，积极支持中国经济的建设和发展。从基础设施建设到制造业崛起，从中国制造到中国创造，从出口驱动到推动内需，3M将企业的发展战略与中国的发展步伐紧密相连，助力中国市场的快速发展。
3M中国致力开发适合本地市场和客户需求的创新科技和产品，并专注创新人才的培养。目前，3M中国已拥有超过500名本土研发人员，贡献了约千项专利发明，并在 3M全球的研发网络中发挥着极为重要的作用。
exhibitors.companyDescriptionEn:
Founded in 1902, 3M is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota, USA. As a world-leading innovative corporation, 3M has developed a wide range of technologies and products that improve our daily lives. Total more than 60,000 high-quality products over the course of 100-plus years, 3M’s products range from household to healthcare, from transportation, construction to business, education, electronics and telecommunication, and so on.
Registered in China in November 1984, 3M China was the first wholly foreign-invested enterprise established outside the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone. To date, 3M established 9 manufacturing facilities, 20 branch offices, 4 technical centers and 1 R&D centers.
As one of the first foreign-invested enterprises registered in China, 3M China has achieved rapid growth over the past 30 years, in tune with the rhythm of China’s economic development. Holding “In China, For China” as its core strategy, 3M has greater involvement in the development of Chinese economy by leveraging its diversified technologies and multiple solutions. From infrastructure construction to manufacturing, from “Made in China” to “Created by China”, from export-driven growth to boosting domestic demand, 3M rides on the tide of China’s economic development by keeping in step with and helping drive forward the Chinese economy, making it one of the most successfully localized companies in China.
3M China is dedicated to the development of innovative technologies and products that meet local customers’ needs. It also focuses on fostering local innovative talents. 3M China now has over 500 R&D employees, which have contributed to around one thousand patents and plays a significant role in 3M’s R&D network.
3M China actively participated in the social responsibility events including environment protection, poverty alleviation and volunteer activities. 3M’s continuous efforts to the society have been widely recognized, proved by an extensive list of accolades that include "Top Companies for Leadership in the Greater China Region", "Most Admired Foreign-invested Enterprises in China", and "Top 20 Most Admired Company in Asia". It also got selected for and ranked top on the "Fortune 500 Companies’ Contributions List in China" for several times.

TSRC is celebrating its 50-year anniversary this year. For decades, TSRC provides solutions using Styrene Block Copolymers (SBC) materials. Through adhesives, hygiene, medical, automobiles, and a number of special-application materials, TSRC works with customers to create safer products for a healthy, sustainable, and ecofriendly life.

TSRC is committed to undertake corporate sustainability as its mission and seeks to cooperate with upstream and downstream partners to develop scientific solutions, including creating ecofriendly and low-carbon solutions. The special-purpose SBC has recyclable characteristics that can reduce the environmental impact of disposable waste. Furthermore, the use of SBC can also help customers reduce energy consumption in the production process, eliminate the use of organic solvents, and launch green products based on renewable raw materials. By providing environmentally sound and pragmatic solutions, TSRC is honored to contribute to sustainable development and become part of the force to protect our planet.

本公司拥有混塑、造粒、挤塑、发泡等生产辐照交联聚乙烯泡棉成套设备和相关检测设备。年生产辐照交联聚乙烯泡棉3000吨以上并通过了国家塑料制品质量检测中心检测。其具有绝缘、保温、隔热、吸音、密封、抗震、耐腐蚀和耐候性强等特点，可广泛应用于国内外汽车、家用电器（包括冰箱、冰柜、空调、微波炉、洗衣机等）、中央空调工程、建筑工业、船舶工业、体育器材、健康旅游、鞋材、包装等领域。
exhibitors.companyDescriptionEn:
Hangzhou Lin'an Jinshuo Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise. The company is specializing in research and development, production, and sales of electronic cross-linked polyethylene foam (IXPE), chemical cross-linking (XPE), and environmentally friendly plastic films.
Our company has a complete set of equipment and related testing equipment for the production of irradiated cross-linked polyethylene foam, including mixing, granulation, extrusion, and foaming. The annual production of irradiated cross-linked polyethylene foam exceeds 3000 tons and has passed the testing of the National Plastic Product Quality Testing Center.
It has the characteristics of insulation, insulation, heat insulation, sound absorption, sealing, seismic resistance, corrosion resistance, and strong weather resistance, and can be widely used in domestic and foreign fields such as automobiles, household appliances (including refrigerators, freezers, air conditioners, microwaves, washing machines, etc.), central air conditioning engineering, construction industry, shipbuilding industry, sports equipment, health tourism, shoe materials, packaging, etc.

启光集团成立于1988年，是一家专业从事聚氨酯原材料、催化剂、助剂的研发生产及销售的企业。产品应用于航天、汽车、家具、建筑、保温、鞋底、皮革、涂料等行业。
公司总部位于上海，目前在国内有四个生产基地和一个研发中心，其中上海道康主要生产各种有机硅表面活性剂及各种催化剂；淄博道康主要生产色浆、抗氧剂及各种催化剂；山东中科主要生产各种硬泡催化；贵州名德主要生产各种锡类催化剂。
公司在国内各省市有20个分公司及办事处，已在中国台湾（台北）、越南（胡志明、河内）、泰国（曼谷）、马来西亚（吉隆坡）、印尼（雅加达）、印度（孟买、新德里、金奈）、南非（约翰内斯堡）、阿拉伯（迪拜）、澳大利亚（墨尔本）、比利时（布鲁塞尔）、美国休斯敦等设有销售公司及技术服务。我们致力于为客户提供更具竞争力的产品及解决方案。
公司秉承“启光就在你身边”、“共生共赢”的经营理念，在聚氨酯行业勇做先锋。
exhibitors.companyDescriptionEn:
Founded in 1988, Qiguang Group is an enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of polyurethane raw materials, catalysts and auxiliaries. Products are used in aerospace, automotive, furniture, construction, insulation, soles, leather, coatings and other industries.
Headquartered in Shanghai, the company currently has four production bases and a research and development center in China, of which Shanghai Daokang mainly produces various silicone surfactants and various catalysts; Zibo Daokang mainly produces color paste, antioxidant and various catalysts; Shandong Zhongke mainly produces various hard foam catalysis; Guizhou Mingde mainly produces various tin catalysts.
